speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The suggestion that hospitals may prematurely discharge patients due to the zero tolerance against abuse policy creates a false dilemma.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The great majority of patients are respectful and appreciative to healthcare workers.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: As for the very small minority who are abusive, they typically do not require urgent care and may not even be patients.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: It is also not difficult to identify such behaviour and actions, which the common man or woman will find unacceptable.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: As for the rare instances where a patient requiring urgent care is abusive, we will manage them sensitively and, as was also previously explained, care will be delivered as needed.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Ultimately, the zero-tolerance policy against abuse is about drawing a line between right and wrong, and being fair to healthcare workers and the great majority of patients.

speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
text: Are there a series of warnings or other types of escalating measures that healthcare institutions can take with patients and/or their family members for behaviour that constitutes abuse or harassment?

speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
text: For example, would there be any intervention from a social worker or someone with conflict resolution training to ensure that healthcare staff do not deal with the situation alone?

speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
text: What is the process before any punitive action is taken against these individuals?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: These are all things that are available to them at this juncture.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: But at this juncture, there are already efforts in place to de-escalate, to give warnings, to make sure that it does not come to that situation.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: We are working on this framework and, hopefully, when this comes out, it will be a better situation for all.

speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
text: I am just wondering when this framework is going to be ready.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: I believe we had made some announcements and indication of the next phase of the efforts of the Work Group.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: We will inform the public and give updates on this in due course.
